summary: SLOOP 2.3, a live groovebox firmware with three synth tracks and a drum track, built for playing and recording by hand rather than loading factory patterns. Marked beta.
features: Nine engines and 68 sounds; 32 user preset slots
37 level-matched drum kits; three user sample slots with web CHOP
Hold-a-button layers: 16 punch-in effects, note repeat, erase, mute
64 steps per track with own lengths; overdub recording; sections A-D
USB and TRS MIDI in, MIDI clock in; USB audio
8 synth voices shared; no Bluetooth MIDI or USB keyboard host

headings: play it live: hold a button, touch a key
lights for playing in the dark 2.3
the menu: settings of the fm-1
usb audio: record the fm-1 on a computer
